name: Apps
description: Build and ship small web apps, dashboards, and custom interfaces.
examples: Build me an app to manage the leads sheet
Create a dashboard over the Q3 competitor research sheet
Add an edit form to the inventory app and republish it
The orders app is erroring — check its logs
Roll the app back to the previous version
long_description: Apps turns an agent into an app developer. It scaffolds from the strict Hivy app template (a Go backend plus a static Vite/React SPA over exactly one sheet), implements API handlers and the interface, builds the bundles, and publishes to a stable URL with authenticated access for the whole channel. Deploys are versioned with one-call rollback, and production logs are always a tool call away. Works with the Sheets plugin, which owns the data the app is built over.
